name: The Unsent Letter
summary: A sealed letter from Edwin VanCleef awaits Baros Alexston, Stormwind's City Architect. Its delivery brings their shared past to light.

sections.title: A Message From the Grave
sections.body: A sealed letter rests in Edwin VanCleef's clothing aboard his juggernaut beneath Moonbrook. Newly penned, it bears Baros Alexston's name. VanCleef chose the City Architect, not a criminal lieutenant or financier.

sections.title: Architects of Old
sections.body:
Take the letter to City Hall in Cathedral Square. Baros Alexston worked beside Edwin VanCleef during Stormwind's rebuilding after the Second War. News of VanCleef's death leaves him disbelieving and horrified by the bandit leader's indiscriminate violence.

Alexston understands the grievance behind VanCleef's bitter crusade. VanCleef was an uncompromising idealist, consumed by betrayal. His grievance was rightful, but it turned to destructive madness.

faq.q: Where do I find the Unsent Letter?
faq.answer: You find the Unsent Letter on Edwin VanCleef aboard his ironclad ship in the Deadmines, deep in Westfall.
Baros Alexston is Stormwind's City Architect. He lives in City Hall, along the northeast edge of Cathedral Square.

faq.q: Why was Edwin VanCleef writing to the City Architect?
faq.answer: Edwin VanCleef and Baros Alexston were fellow stonemasons who rebuilt Stormwind after the Second War. Even after turning to banditry, VanCleef regarded Alexston as a former peer tied to the masons' work and betrayal.

faq.q: What does the letter reveal about VanCleef?
faq.answer: Alexston sees VanCleef as an idealist and a romantic to the end, poisoned by vengeance. VanCleef believed his war against the kingdom was justified because the ruling nobility refused to pay the masons.

faq.q: Do I need to finish the main Defias Brotherhood chain before turning this in?
aliases: can i do unsent letter early
faq.answer: No. Any Alliance adventurer who defeats VanCleef can take the letter, regardless of prior progress in the Defias Brotherhood storyline.

faq.q: Where does this questline lead next?
faq.answer: After you deliver the letter, Alexston sends you to the Stockade to question Bazil Thredd, an imprisoned Defias leader who may know more about VanCleef's plans.

angles.text: As a human of Stormwind, you can see the wounds left by the kingdom's reconstruction. Political betrayals within the capital gave rise to banditry in Westfall.
As a rogue, you can see how VanCleef's skill as a fighter and organizer gave way to suicidal obsession.
As an Alliance member, you can see how the letter ties the Defias threat to Stormwind's civic administration. It reveals a vendetta beyond a regional outlaw uprising.
